normalization_policy: The official source publishes month-level granularity only. Historical scoring uses the final instant of that month as a conservative upper bound; it never substitutes an earlier date.

claims_used: Llama 3.1 includes an 8B instruction-tuned text model.
The model is static and trained on an offline dataset.

required_before_scoring: Acquire the local artifact without modifying its weights.
Record the exact local model digest as sha256:<64 hex digest>.
Create a scoring metadata JSON using that digest as immutable_version.
Keep execution_mode=local and disable external tools or web access.

notes: This record establishes model-family provenance only. It does not pretend that an unfrozen Ollama tag is an immutable model artifact.
